items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Composed Christopher Columbus. Yeah. You went up to Chicago, you must have been to Chicago too since you know the streets and everything.

ctx.x: Composed Christopher Columbus. Yeah. You went up to Chicago, you must have been to Chicago too since you know the streets and everything.
Oh I lived in Chicago. Oh you did? But I wasn't playing music, you understand. I didn't learn how to play music until I come back, yeah.
